hypothesis: The unchanged pooled ETH compression-pullback route can add materially higher portfolio cadence while retaining positive after-cost long-and-short forward economics without dependence on one winner.
why_this_revision: Revision 7 started the isolated observer after new third-lifecycle evidence but did not freeze a future decision cutoff. Revision 8 excludes the entire inspected prefix and predeclares the next whole-minute boundary before it occurs. No strategy, parameter, route, exit, risk, or authority changes.
decision: Continue the exact report-only observer. Score only decisions at or after the frozen cutoff. Do not use the startup prefix, older live trades, or opened historical final block as prospective confirmation.

minimum_evidence_to_update.diagnostic: At least one source-attributable eligible event on each configured side with complete decision, completed bar, executable book, and markout coverage.
minimum_evidence_to_update.approval_ready: A compatible prospective window with resolved long and short lifecycles, exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop path, missed-opportunity accounting, positive net and profit factor above one, and positive net after removing the largest winner.

comparison_contract.baseline: Keep v53 unchanged and do not add ETH.
comparison_contract.candidate: Add the unchanged pooled ETH route only after an approval-ready proposal and explicit human approval.
guardrails: realized entry slippage remains within the frozen stress envelope
portfolio overlap and simultaneous-loss behavior reviewed

risks_and_failure_modes: Historical edge is small, low-win-rate, and selected after multiple trials.
The opened final historical block becomes negative after removing its largest winner.
Three older live lifecycles remain too sparse and are excluded from prospective confirmation.
Long and short mechanism leadership may rotate again.
The observer records decisions rather than executable counterfactual lifecycles until exact follow-up evidence is attached.
A long open-ended window may cross regimes and must retain regime labels rather than silently pooling incompatible conditions.
rejection_or_redesign_triggers: Either configured side is persistently negative after exact costs.
Combined prospective net becomes nonpositive after removing its largest winner.
Signal cadence materially under-delivers the historical 6.48-per-week estimate.
Source, feature, identity, timing, stop, funding, or execution evidence is incomplete.
A new parameter, side, relation, horizon, or regime subset is selected after observing this window.
